points.why: The table gives each check's scope (paths executed, files pointed at) and what a pass can detect (asserted behaviour, syntax/style).
It states the config file never loaded by tests is outside the test suite's reach.
It fixes the checks themselves: config-load tests, CI that enumerates all config files and fails on any without a loader test, and repo-wide coverage listing.
It says a passing check only vouches for what it exercises and requires reports to list what was not verified.
